Package frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Simulation

Class MechanismSimState

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Simulation.MechanismSimState
public final class MechanismSimState extends Object
Mutable state container for a single degree of freedom mechanism simulation.

Units follow the mechanism conventions selected by the sim. Position and velocity are in the output units of the mechanism, such as radians for rotary mechanisms or meters for linear mechanisms.
